# 第 1 章讲解

## 读前

《柳林风声》1908 年在英国出版，写河边几只小动物的日子。他们像当年英国乡间的绅士一样过日子：划船、野餐、串门。spring-cleaning 是英国人家每年春天的大扫除。

- **the Mole**：鼹鼠，住在地下的小房子里
- **the Water Rat**：河鼠，住在河岸的洞里
- **the Otter**：水獭，河鼠的熟人
- **the Badger**：獾，住在野树林深处

### 本章的词

- **scull** /skʌl/ v. 用短桨划船
- **bank** /bæŋk/ n. 河岸
- **fellow** /ˈfeləʊ/ n. 家伙，伙计
- **trot** /trɒt/ v. 小跑
- **luncheon-basket** /ˈlʌntʃən ˌbɑːskɪt/ n. 野餐篮
- **row** /rəʊ/ v. 划船

## 长难句

### 1. small wonder that：真正的主语在后面

> It was small wonder, then, that he suddenly flung down his brush on the floor, said, “Bother!” and “O blow!” and also “Hang spring-cleaning!” and bolted out of the house without even waiting to put on his coat.

- **结构**：it 占位、并列
- **注**：bolt 猛冲
- **试**：真正的主语从哪个词开始？

| 断句 | 顺读 |
| --- | --- |
| **It** **was** small wonder, | 难怪（这件事）—— |
| · then, | 所以说， |
| that he suddenly flung down his brush on the floor, | ——就是他突然把刷子往地上一扔， |
| said, “Bother!” and “O blow!” | 嘴里喊着“烦死了！”“哎呀！” |
| and also “Hang spring-cleaning!” | 还有“大扫除见鬼去吧！” |
| and bolted out of the house | 然后冲出了家门， |
| · without even waiting to put on his coat. | 连外套都没等穿上。 |

- **答**：that
- **卡点**：`small wonder` 不是“小小的奇迹”，是“难怪，不足为奇”。
- **译**：所以难怪他突然把刷子往地上一扔，嘴里喊着“烦死了！”“哎呀，去它的！”还有“大扫除见鬼去吧！”，连外套都没等穿上就冲出了家门。

### 2. 句首的分词：谁在蹦

> Jumping off all his four legs at once, in the joy of living and the delight of spring without its cleaning, he pursued his way across the meadow till he reached the hedge on the further side.

- **结构**：非谓语
- **试**：Jumping off 是谁做的？

| 断句 | 顺读 |
| --- | --- |
| · Jumping off all his four legs at once, | 四条腿一齐蹦起来， |
| · in the joy of living | 带着活着的快乐 |
| · and the delight of spring without its cleaning, | 和不用大扫除的春天的欢喜， |
| **he** **pursued** his way across the meadow | 他穿过草地往前走， |
| · till he reached the hedge on the further side. | 一直走到对面的树篱。 |

- **答**：he

### 3. who、as、what 一层套一层

> He was bowled over in an instant by the impatient and contemptuous Mole, who trotted along the side of the hedge chaffing the other rabbits as they peeped hurriedly from their holes to see what the row was about.

- **结构**：多层从句、指代
- **试**：who 引出的从句，谓语是哪个词？

| 断句 | 顺读 |
| --- | --- |
| **He** **was bowled over** in an instant | 他一下子被撞翻了， |
| · by the impatient and contemptuous Mole, | 撞他的是又急又瞧不起人的鼹鼠， |
| · · who trotted along the side of the hedge | 他（鼹鼠）沿着树篱一路小跑， |
| · · chaffing the other rabbits | 边跑边取笑别的兔子， |
| · · as they peeped hurriedly from their holes | 兔子们这时慌忙从洞里探出头来， |
| · · to see what the row was about. | 想看看在闹什么。 |

- **答**：trotted

### 4. allude to it：it 指前面的麻烦

> The Mole knew well that it is quite against animal-etiquette to dwell on possible trouble ahead, or even to allude to it; so he dropped the subject.

- **结构**：指代、it 占位
- **注**：allude to 提到，暗指
- **试**：allude to it 的 it 指什么？

| 断句 | 顺读 |
| --- | --- |
| **The Mole** **knew** well | 鼹鼠很清楚： |
| that it is quite against animal-etiquette | 这很不合动物的规矩—— |
| · to dwell on possible trouble ahead, | 老想着前头可能有的麻烦， |
| · or even to allude to it; | 哪怕只提一句它（麻烦）； |
| so **he** **dropped** the subject. | 所以他就不再提这件事了。 |

- **答**：possible trouble ahead
- **卡点**：`allude to it` 的 it 指前面的 `possible trouble ahead`，不是指 animal-etiquette。
- **译**：鼹鼠很清楚，老念叨前头可能有的麻烦，哪怕只提一句，都很不合动物的规矩，所以他就不再提这件事了。

## 理解

1. 鼹鼠为什么扔下刷子跑出了家门？
2. 河鼠说起野树林里的居民时，口气有什么变化？说明了什么？

**答案**

1. 春天的气息钻进了他的地下小屋，他再也待不住，大扫除也不想做了。
   原文：*Spring was moving in the air above and in the earth below and around him*
   译：春意在上面的空气里涌动，也在他身下和四周的泥土里涌动
2. 说到松鼠、兔子还算轻松，说到黄鼠狼这些就吞吞吐吐，可见他对它们并不放心。
   原文：*explained the Rat in a hesitating sort of way*
   译：河鼠吞吞吐吐地解释道

## 词的用法

- **make for**：后面接地点，表示朝那里走去，常带点急。
  词典：phr. 朝……走去
  掌握：会用
  原文：*he made for the steep little tunnel*
  译：他朝那条又陡又小的隧道奔去
  例：When the rain started, we made for the nearest café.
- **take to**：take to doing，开始做并成了习惯；take to sb，开始喜欢某人。to 是介词。
  词典：phr. 开始（经常）做；开始喜欢
  掌握：会用
  原文：*Then he tired of that and took to punting.*
  译：后来他玩腻了，又迷上了撑篙行船。
  例：She has taken to walking to work.

## 复述

用 5–8 句英文复述鼹鼠这一天在河上的经历，提示词：scull, bank, trot, take to

参考：The Mole stops his spring-cleaning and runs out into the spring sunshine. He trots across the meadow and comes to a river for the first time. The Water Rat sculls over from the other bank and takes him out in his boat. They have a picnic, and they meet the Otter. On the way home, the Mole grabs the sculls, and the boat goes over. The Rat pulls him out of the water and forgives him. The Mole stays with the Rat, and soon he takes to life on the river.

## 卡句

### 1. 三个过去分词：都是“看呆了”

> The Mole was bewitched, entranced, fascinated.

- **结构**：词汇
- **标记**：有生词
- **注**：bewitch 迷住；entrance 使出神；fascinate 使着迷

| 断句 | 顺读 |
| --- | --- |
| **The Mole** **was** bewitched, | 鼹鼠着了魔， |
| entranced, fascinated. | 出了神，入了迷。 |

- **译**：鼹鼠看呆了，像着了魔一样，挪不开眼。

### 2. he being new to …：自带主语的分词

> “Oh, it’s all very well to talk,” said the Mole rather pettishly, he being new to a river and riverside life and its ways.

- **结构**：独立结构
- **标记**：词都认识
- **试**：being 的主语是哪个词？

| 断句 | 顺读 |
| --- | --- |
| “Oh, it’s all very well to talk,” | “哼，你说得倒轻巧，” |
| **said** **the Mole** rather pettishly, | 鼹鼠有点不高兴地说， |
| · he being new to a river | 他（鼹鼠）刚到河边， |
| · and riverside life and its ways. | 对河上的生活和规矩都还陌生。 |

- **答**：he
- **卡点**：`he being new to a river` 是独立结构，being 的主语是 he，说明鼹鼠为什么不高兴：他是第一次来河边。
- **译**：“哼，你说得倒轻巧。”鼹鼠有点不高兴地说，他刚到河边，对河上的生活和规矩都还陌生。
